title: primalucelib never recovered once a reply arrived after its request had timed out
summary: Each request read the next line, so after one late reply (a SESTO SENSO 3 restart, a slow answer) every reply answered the previous request: FOCUSER_POSITION alternated OK/ALERT and moves failed on the owner's SESTO SENSO 3.
evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md (FND-000053); owner log 2026-10-23; test_primalucelib a_duplicate_reply_is_discarded and a_late_reply_is_skipped fail with the previous library

resolution.evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: pending input is discarded before each request and replies without the request verb are dropped (at most PRIMALUCE_MAX_STALE_REPLIES); 23/23 library cases and the recorded simulator run pass; hardware moves after the fix.
